title: Cash Pickup Shortfall Credits: Prompt-Notice Courtesy
content:
**Error-resolution team table.** A prompt-notice courtesy is added to Paloma's shortfall credit on a short Cash Pickup payout. It rewards an incorrect-amount notice given soon after the cash was paid out.

**Days counted.** The calendar days from the payout date to the date of the notice. The payout date is the date of the cash payout recorded on the transfer, and the payout day is not counted.

| Days from payout to notice | Prompt-notice courtesy added (USD) |
|---|---|
| up to 7 | 1.00 |
| more than 7, up to 30 | 0.50 |
| more than 30 | none |

## Boundary cases (hypothetical payout on 2 May)

| Notice dated | Days | Courtesy |
|---|---|---|
| 2 May | 0 | 1.00 |
| 9 May | 7 | 1.00 |
| 10 May | 8 | 0.50 |
| 1 June | 30 | 0.50 |
| 2 June | 31 | none |
